hook: 字根 sci＝知——觀測台專管「知道／良知」。
script: science 系統之知；conscious 有意識知道。conscience 良心那盞燈；omniscient 全知。prescient 預先知道；nescient／nescience 無知。plebiscite 全民表決像集體表態所知；unconscionable 違背良心到不可接受。

members.speakLineEn: A researcher's conscience should stop p-hacking.
members.speakLineZh: 研究者良心應阻止 p 值操弄。

members.senseAnchor: possessed of universal or complete knowledge
members.speakLineEn: No reviewer is omniscient across fields.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有審稿人跨領域全知。

members.senseAnchor: able to know what will happen in the future
members.speakLineEn: Her prescient warning about overfitting aged well.
members.speakLineZh: 她對過度擬合的先見經得起時間。

members.speakLineEn: Admit nescience rather than invent certainty.
members.speakLineZh: 承認無知勝過捏造確定。
